neutralCapabilitySummary: Reconcile heterogeneous client assessment evidence into a validated report-data contract, then delegate deterministic document rendering to an isolated and verified renderer.
neutralIntentExamples: render a verified client assessment report from a validated evidence contract

operations: discover client-scoped evidence, parse scores and findings, preserve missing dimensions, validate a bounded data structure, render, and verify the resulting document
outputs: validated report data, rendered client document, source index, and rendering receipt
failureBehavior: retain validated report data and expose the exact renderer or dependency failure without installing software implicitly
materialRisks: loose parsing can misattribute scores

neutralCapabilitySummary: Inspect an agent capability installation against an explicit manifest and report availability, integrity, version evidence, missing bindings, and safe remediation options.

neutralCapabilitySummary: Generate a structured portfolio of platform-specific post concepts by crossing a small set of audience-relevant pillars with distinct editorial formats.

exclusions: forcing one platform's format onto all channels

materialRisks: a fixed matrix can become formulaic
platform-specific output rules can reduce portability
surface assumptions can trigger unwanted file writes

neutralCapabilitySummary: Model and tune difficulty, progression, pacing, economy, and randomness with visible curves and measured player outcomes rather than unsupported intuition.

neutralCapabilitySummary: Create and maintain a canonical, versioned product-marketing context that downstream work can reuse without repeatedly reconstructing audience, positioning, evidence, objections, and voice.
neutralIntentExamples: build a reusable product-marketing context from product, audience, positioning, and proof evidence

forcing business-to-business sections onto unrelated products

neutralCapabilitySummary: Draft a jurisdiction-scoped business agreement or proposal from explicit party, scope, commercial, data, ownership, acceptance, liability, and termination requirements for qualified review.

inputs: document type, jurisdiction, parties, authority, scope, value, dates, and special requirements

neutralCapabilitySummary: Build a resumable marketing operating plan that connects product context, funnel stages, budget, ownership, measurement, and execution capacity across near-term and annual horizons.
